transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my right knee. It's been getting worse.
Could you tell me a bit about when your right knee problem first started and how it came on, and also whether you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
It's ached on and off about three years now.

Can you tell me how things are with your knee at the moment and how much it affects your day-to-day life, and also what medicines you take regularly or have taken recently—including any new or changed ones, with doses if you know them?
I can't walk the dog round the park anymore.
Could you tell me about any other health problems you’ve had, now or in the past, and any operations or times you’ve been in hospital?
I've had diabetes for about ten years.
Have you ever had an allergy or a bad reaction to any medicine?
Penicillin gives me a rash.
How much is your knee problem affecting your day-to-day life at the moment—not much, somewhat, or a lot, or are you not sure?
A lot. I go downstairs one step at a time now.
Could you tell me what medicines you’re taking regularly right now, and whether any have been newly started or changed recently—including the dose if you know it?
My wife sorts out all my tablets, I just take them.
Besides the trouble going down stairs, has anything else come along with your knee problem?
It swells a bit by evening. Reminds me of my old dog actually.
Is there anything you’ve noticed that makes your knee feel better or worse?
Worse after walking more than ten minutes.
You mentioned your diabetes, which you’ve had for about ten years—apart from that, is there anything else you see a doctor or nurse about regularly?
I had a stent put in, in my heart.
Since your knee started getting worse, have you noticed any changes in your appetite, sleep, weight, or energy?
No, nothing like that.
What worries you most about your knee?
I'd like something stronger for the pain.
Other than the heart stent you mentioned, have you had any other operations or hospital stays?
No, nothing else. My son had his hip done, though.
Since your knee started getting worse, have you noticed any changes in your bladder or bowel habits, or in your breathing?
No, all fine there.
Is there anything else you’ve noticed about your knee that you haven’t mentioned yet?
It's stiff for about twenty minutes each morning.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
